biotools.summary: BarcodeBERT is a specialized family of transformer models designed for high-throughput taxonomic identification of DNA barcodes in biodiversity analyses. It outperforms general machine learning methods and BLAST by providing rapid and accurate species-level classification.
biotools.name: BarcodeBERT: Transformers for Biodiversity Analysis
